description: Weekly, grouped, automerged dependency updates with a 3-day minimum release age

packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one weekly PR and merge it once CI passes; majors wait for review
Runtime dependency updates commit as fix(<repo>) so release tooling ships a patch; a group with any runtime update takes the fix type, dev-only updates stay chore

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
